newsitem.title: FRANCE: Eramet easier amid worries on outlook.
newsitem.headline: Eramet easier amid worries on outlook.

text.p: French nickel mining company Eramet was off 4.61 percent at mid-afternoon on Wednesday as investors remained worried about the outlook for ownership of a disputed nickel mine in northern New Caledonia.
By 1310 GMT, Eramet was off 14.80 francs at 263.0.
Eramet is against any move by the government that might force it to cede nickel assets and resources to independence groups in New Caledonia.
Uncertainty surrounding the future of Eramet's management team and strategy was also driving the shares lower, traders said.

Eramet stock hit a year-low of 247 francs on Tuesday but rebounded to close at 277.80 francs after the French government said it had no plans to strip part of Eramet's mining assets in New Caledonia as part of negotiations over mining reserves in the French territory.
